newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Libbey EPS estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Libbey EPS estimate cut.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said Tuesday it cut 1996 Libbey Inc earnings estimates after Libbey said it expects a flat or nearly-flat third quarter. It was off 2-1/2 to 23-7/8 after the statement.

-- Analyst Douglas Lane said in a telephone interview he kept near-term accumulate and long-term buy ratings but cut his 1996 earnings estimate to $2.10 from $2.20 a share and 1997's to $2.35-$2.40 from $2.50 versus 1995's $1.95 (adjusted to include all stock options outstanding as common stock equivalents).
-- Core business is on track but margin improvements from re-engineering appear delayed until 1997, he said.
